gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-questrial: Expressive and widely spaced, Bushcraft barely lifts its capitals above the lowercase, while Questrial cuts flat, stencil-like strokes. Bushcraft is best at making a statement; Questrial is best at explaining it plainly.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-radio-canada: Extra-wide spacing gives Bushcraft its stretched-out look, while Radio Canada stands tall and full in a plain sans with open curve endings. Shrink the heading and that spacing loses its drama.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-radio-canada-big: Expressive from the first letter, Bushcraft sets the tone. Radio Canada Big, a monoline plain sans with an x-height that fills the line, gives those closed, widely spaced heading letters open forms to rest against.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro opens broad gaps at its terminals, a sharp contrast to the closed, widely spaced letters of Bushcraft. Readex Pro holds its weight word after word, so paragraphs of sans text move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-roboto: Roboto reads clean and open, with generous mouths on its round letters. Over paragraphs of this plain sans, the low capital-to-lowercase contrast keeps the eye moving, while Bushcraft holds one stroke width in the heading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-ruda: Bushcraft spaces its closed letters extra wide, with capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Ruda, wire-like with a sizable x-height, does the screen reading that a display face never will.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-saira: Stretched out and closed up, this is Bushcraft at full volume. Bushcraft is best looked at; Saira, with see-through s shapes and rounds stretching toward the top line, is best read.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-sarpanch: A constant stroke weight with no sparkle defines Bushcraft, while Sarpanch, a plain sans, opens its lowercase e clearly. Bushcraft earns its keep when it runs big and brief.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-savate: Signage-plain letters, spaced wide and shut tight. Bushcraft does best as a single expressive line, while Savate, a sans-serif with open curves and sturdy hairlines, does best as the text beneath.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-schibsted-grotes: Approachable Schibsted Grotesk, a plain sans with big open e and a, sits beneath Bushcraft, whose lines hold their width through every turn. And over paragraphs its terminals never close in, so the text keeps moving.
